plan.title: Paired treatment-response DE in blood
plan.analytical_narrative: The question is which genes respond to treatment within each subject: 5 subjects each contribute one control and one treated sample (10 samples, 12,000 genes, raw STAR/featureCounts counts). Because every subject is its own control, the between-subject variation must be removed inside the model, not by collapsing subjects: the DESeq2 design ~ subject + condition tests the condition coefficient across subject-matched pairs, which is exactly the within-subject response (rule R-0011@233b). With 5 replicates per group (within the 2–11 range), the DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage is the primary method (R-0001@9a17), a minimal 10-count pre-filter leaves power to the independent filter (R-0029@fa6d), median-of-ratios size factors normalize inside the model (R-0026@9ab1), and BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering selects the results (R-0010@91a5, R-0043@4f55). At n=5 pairs the replicate count is small, so the plan adds a second permitted method for the paired design, limma-voom with duplicateCorrelation (the alternative of R-0011@233b), and reports the DESeq2/limma overlap as the robustness check of R-0042@54e1 — with only 5 pairs, single-method calls are treated as provisional. No pathway/enrichment step is included: the research question asks only for responding genes. QC precedes the test (blind vst PCA and sample distances, R-0033@40bf) to catch outliers and confirm the pairing structure before any inference.
